cli.vault.compare.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.compare.note: Printed BEFORE the fingerprint grid. The safety meaning must survive: the person compares the printed groups with the trusted approval page BEFORE approving. Never say the harness verified anything.

cli.vault.opening.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.opening.note: Followed by the URL on its own line.

cli.vault.open_manually.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.open_manually.note: Shown when no browser could be opened; followed by the URL on its own line.

cli.vault.waiting.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.waiting.note: {minutes} is an integer >= 1. Ctrl+C is a key name; keep it.

cli.vault.connected_until.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.connected_until.note: Leads with the state. {until} is a local date and time already formatted (e.g. 2026-11-14 09:30 PST).

cli.vault.timed_out.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.timed_out.note: The backticked command is literal and stays byte-identical.

cli.vault.interrupted.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell

cli.vault.unavailable.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.unavailable.note: The ONE sentence for the dark state (the service is not switched on yet). Not an error, not an up-sell, no retry advice. Short.

cli.vault.no_access.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.no_access.note: Route 29 refused (403 / vault_no_access). Names the cause and the next step; `lop vault connect` is a command, keep it verbatim.

cli.vault.error.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell

cli.vault.signed_out.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell

cli.vault.not_team.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.not_team.note: The ONLY sentence shown to an account with no team-plan organization: a direct answer, never an up-sell. 'Radient Team' is a plan name; keep it verbatim.

cli.vault.no_endpoint.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.no_endpoint.note: 'agent messages' is the product name of Team Bridge (match cli.team_bridge). The backticked command is literal.

cli.vault.not_eligible.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.not_eligible.note: {org} is an organization name. Direct, no up-sell.

cli.vault.frozen.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.frozen.note: The organization's plan lapsed; matches the console's wording for a frozen organization.

cli.vault.disabled.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell

cli.vault.not_approved.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell

cli.vault.status_no_key.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell

cli.vault.status_not_connected.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.status_not_connected.note: 'active' matches the console's grant states (Active / Expired / Revoked). `lop vault connect` is a command.

cli.vault.disconnected.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.disconnected.note: {count} is how many agent keys were deleted (>= 1). The agent, not the key, is what reads vaults.

cli.vault.nothing_to_remove.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell

cli.vault.revoke_hint.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.revoke_hint.note: Followed by the console URL on its own line. 'Agent access' is the console page title; keep the console's term.

cli.vault.title.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.title.note: First line of the key block. {org} is an organization name (or a tnt_ id). The middle dot is a separator; keep it.

cli.vault.title_bare.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.title_bare.note: cli.vault.title without the organization: used when only the tenant id is known. Must read exactly as cli.vault.title minus its ' · {org}' suffix.

cli.vault.endpoint_row.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.endpoint_row.note: Label/value row. 'Agent endpoint' is the console's own field label (user-console Agent access); keep it identical to the console's term in this locale. {endpoint} is a bep_ id.

cli.vault.fingerprint_label.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.fingerprint_label.note: Label line above the instruction and the 4-line fingerprint grid. 'Key fingerprint' is the console's own field label; match the console's term.

cli.vault.fingerprint_held.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.fingerprint_held.note: Label above the fingerprint grid in `lop vault status` when access is not currently usable: the key still exists on this machine. 'Key fingerprint' is the console label.

cli.vault.compare_stop.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.compare_stop.note: Follows cli.vault.compare on its own line: on any mismatch, do not approve. Short and imperative (the console says 'If they differ, stop.').

cli.vault.connected_scope.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.connected_scope.note: Follows connected_until. 'shared with it' = the vaults the person chose on the approval page.

cli.vault.waiting_seconds.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.waiting_seconds.note: Used when the wait is under a minute. {seconds} is an integer >= 1. Ctrl+C is a key name; keep it.

cli.vault.key_unreadable.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.key_unreadable.note: The stored agent key is damaged or the store could not be read. Both commands are verbatim.

cli.vault.store_error.tone: plain, direct, operator-facing; no alarm, no up-sell
cli.vault.store_error.note: `lop vault disconnect` could not open the local encrypted secret store; nothing was deleted.
